description: This file implements an in-memory repository class for managing MasterRace entities, providing basic CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations and existence checks.

classes.name: InMemoryMasterRaceRepository
classes.description: A simple thread-safe in-memory repository for MasterRace entities implementing IMasterRaceRepository interface.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all MasterRace entities ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a single MasterRace entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new MasterRace entity to the repository.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Removes a MasterRace entity by its Guid, returning true if successful.

methods.name: ExistsByNameAsync
methods.description: Checks if a MasterRace with a given name exists, optionally excluding a specific ID.
